{{nihongo|'''Tsubaki Nakato Shrine'''|都波岐神社・奈加等神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ise Province]].

'''Tsubaki Shrine / Nakato Shrine''' (つばきじんじゃ・なかとじんじゃ) are {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Suzuka, Mie|Q207311|qid=Q207311}}, {{ill|Mie Prefecture|Q128196|qid=Q128196}}.

=== Overview ===
Both are {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, and their former rank under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines}} was {{ill|Ken-sha|lt=kensha|qid=Q90139226}}. Tsubaki Shrine is regarded as an {{ill|Ichinomiya|Q1656379|qid=Q1656379}} of {{ill|Ise Province|Q864166|qid=Q864166}}.

They were merged in the {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} era and are also called '''Tsubaki Nakato Shrine'''.

=== Enshrined deities ===
; Tsubaki Shrine
* {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|Q3090037|qid=Q3090037|lt=Sarutahiko Ōkami}} (さるたひこのおおかみ)

; Nakato Shrine
* Amanokuno-no-Mikoto - ancestor of Nakato no Atai.
* {{ill|Sumiyoshi sanjin|Q1114013|qid=Q1114013|lt=Nakatsutsu-no-o-no-Mikoto}} (なかつつおのみこと)

=== History ===
According to shrine tradition, in year 23 of {{ill|Emperor Yūryaku|Q357235|qid=Q357235}}, by {{ill|Command paper|Q905765|qid=Q905765}}, Takao Tsuka-no-Mikoto, {{ill|Ise no Kuni no Miyatsuko|Q11378974|qid=Q11378974}}, built two shrine buildings in {{ill|Ise Province|Q864166|qid=Q864166}} {{ill|Kawawa district|Q11553861|qid=Q11553861}} {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Nakato Village}} (current location), naming them Tsubaki Shrine and Nakato Shrine. In the '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}' both are listed as small shrines. During {{ill|Tenchō|Q1373138|qid=Q1373138}}, {{ill|Kūkai|Q222227|qid=Q222227|lt=Kōbō Daishi (Kūkai)}} entered seclusion here and {{ill|Votive offering|Q2601788|qid=Q2601788}} two {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=lion heads}}. In {{ill|Jōryaku|Q279743|qid=Q279743}} 3 ({{ill|1079|Q19445|qid=Q19445}}), both shrines were granted {{ill|Senior First Rank|Q11123258|qid=Q11123258}} in {{ill|Shinkai (divine rank)|Q11591025|qid=Q11591025}}, and {{ill|Emperor Shirakawa|Q60949|qid=Q60949}} granted an imperial-calligraphy {{ill|imperial plaque|Q11071212|qid=Q11071212}} plaque. In the {{ill|Eiroku|Q1143341|qid=Q1143341}} years, shrine buildings burned during {{ill|Oda Nobunaga|Q171411|qid=Q171411}}'s pacification of Ise and old records were lost. In the {{ill|Kan'ei|es|Kan'ei|fa|کانئی|fr|Ère Kan'ei|id|Kan'ei|ja|寛永|ko|간에이|ru|Канъэй|simple|Kan'ei|sr|Канеи|sv|Kanei|tr|Kan'ei|zh|寬永|qid=Q1192913}} years, they were rebuilt by Ichiyanagi Kenmotsu, lord of {{ill|Kanbe Castle|Q11589845|qid=Q11589845}}.

In Meiji, both shrines were combined and ranked {{ill|Ken-sha|lt=kensha|qid=Q90139226}} as "Tsubaki Shrine Nakato Shrine." Today the deities of both are enshrined as {{ill|Saijin|Q11591100|qid=Q11591100|lt=aidono}} in one shrine building.

=== Access ===
; Route bus
* From {{ill|Kawarada Station|Q4559716|qid=Q4559716}} ({{ill|Central Japan Railway Company|ckb|کۆمپانیای ناوەڕاستی ڕێگای ئاسنینی ژاپۆن|cs|JR Central|da|Central Japan Railway Company|de|Central Japan Railway Company|eo|JR Centra|es|Central Japan Railway Company|fa|شرکت راه‌آهن مرکزی ژاپن|fi|JR Tōkai|fr|Central Japan Railway Company|hu|Central Japan Railway Company|id|Perusahaan Kereta Api Jepang Tengah|it|Central Japan Railway Company|ja|東海旅客鉄道|jv|Central Japan Railway Company|ko|도카이 여객철도|ms|Syarikat Kereta Api Jepun Tengah|nds|JR Tōkai|nl|Central Japan Railway Company|pl|Central Japan Railway Company|pt|Central Japan Railway Company|ru|Central Japan Railway Company|su|Pausahaan Japan Railway Tengah|sv|JR Tokai|th|บริษัทรถไฟญี่ปุ่นตอนกลาง|tl|Central Japan Railway Company|tr|Central Japan Railway Company|uk|Central Japan Railway Company|ur|سنٹرل جاپان ریلوے کمپنی|wuu|东海旅客铁道|zh|東海旅客鐵道|zh_yue|東海旅客鐵道|qid=Q513679|lt=JR}} {{ill|Kansai line|Q11656377|qid=Q11656377|lt=Kansai Main Line}}, {{ill|Ise Railway|Q11379148|qid=Q11379148}} {{ill|Ise Line|Q6079603|qid=Q6079603|lt=Ise Line}}) or {{ill|Suzukashi Station|Q11649493|qid=Q11649493}} ({{ill|Kintetsu Railway|Q1531085|qid=Q1531085|lt=Kintetsu}} {{ill|Suzuka Line|Q900210|qid=Q900210|lt=Suzuka Line}}), take {{ill|Mie Kotsu|Q6843516|qid=Q6843516}} bus, get off at "Takaoka" stop, about 10 minutes on foot.

; Private car
* Near Ichinomiya-chō intersection about 1 km south of Suzuka Ōhashi on {{ill|Japan National Route 23|Q5357579|qid=Q5357579}}.
